description: Quote a Stock Token swap on chain 4663. Compares 0x, the Uniswap API, on-chain Uniswap v3, and hookless Uniswap v4, and returns the executable route with the higher amountOut. If none is executable, the result is oracle-indicative and is not a fill. Pro required. Does not sign or broadcast.

amountIn.description: Raw token units. Use this or amountInHuman.

firm.description: Request firm 0x calldata when possible. Default true.

notionalUsd.description: Optional USD notional for policy. Not the swap size.

recipient.description: 0x recipient. v3 uses it. v4 pays the signing wallet.

tokenIn.description: Registry symbol or 0x address, e.g. USDG

tokenOut.description: Registry symbol or 0x address, e.g. NVDA

name: stocktoken_quote
